known_limitations: 1 trial per task at temperature 0; does not match the 4-trial leaderboard protocol.
Agent is served by local vLLM; user simulator and NL judge run on DeepSeek, mirroring the frozen baseline.
The 17 test_clean tasks are from the official test split but are the only test tasks entity-disjoint from training; results are development evidence, not a formal gate pass.
Entity isolation is verified from task-definition text only; runtime environment state (shared Retail DB) is not part of the check.
NL assertions are judged by an LLM (DeepSeek); judge variance is possible even at temperature 0.
